metadata.dcterms:title: arXiv:math-ph/0010012v1 10 Oct 2000
metadata.dcterms:creator: Zelditch, Steve
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We review some recent results on random polynomials and their generalizations in complex and symplectic geometry. The main theme is the universality of statistics of zeros and critical points of (generalized) polynomials of degree N on length scales of order D √ N (complex case), resp. D N (real case).
